[1/3] Adopt the studio renderer as the UI surface and add accessible chart/table semantics

impact_assessment.why: The dashboard's SVGs and tables have no accessible names, so screen readers cannot interpret the charts; the auto-adopted UI contract also points at generated, git-ignored files.
impact_assessment.benefits: Charts and tables become screen-reader legible; the UI contract covers the real editable surface; strict delivery can pass.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: HTML changes by added attributes only; dependency: standard library only; concurrency: none; state: generated studio.html only.
impact_assessment.mitigation: String-level tests for titles, captions and scope; full test suite plus the UI guard verify.

[1/3] Give every SVG chart a screen-reader data table with the plotted values

impact_assessment.why: The chart descriptions summarise the shape but not the data; a screen-reader user cannot recover the per-compound properties, docking scores or PK timepoints.
impact_assessment.benefits: WCAG complex-image guidance is met with the underlying values, and sighted and assistive users read the same numbers.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: added hidden tables only, no visible layout change; dependency: standard library only; concurrency: none; state: generated studio.html only.
impact_assessment.mitigation: String-level tests for each table, the full suite, and the UI guard verify.

[1/3] Add the circuit-dynamics data table and share one point parser

impact_assessment.why: The circuit chart still has only a prose description; its per-timepoint PNN and pAKT values are not recoverable by assistive users.
impact_assessment.benefits: The last chart gains a text alternative with the plotted values, and one parser keeps the SVG and table from drifting.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: optional renderer argument, no visible layout change; dependency: standard library only; concurrency: none; state: generated studio.html only.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Parser refactor covered by existing circuit tests plus a new table test; UI guard verify.
